AutocompleteRoot.description: Holds the input's text and the open state, and shares them with the parts inside it through Combobox's `combobox` context.

props.value: The input's text. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control it.
props.defaultValue: The input's text at first, when `value` isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the input's new text: what was typed, or a suggestion's label once chosen. An inline preview isn't reported until it is chosen.
props.mode: How the input completes what is typed: `"list"` filters the suggestions; `"inline"` shows the highlighted suggestion in the input; `"both"` does both; `"none"` neither. It is also the input's `aria-autocomplete`.
props.open: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the popup is open at first, when `open` isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after the popup opened or closed, whatever closed it.
props.disabled: Whether the autocomplete is disabled. Also disabled inside a disabled `FieldRoot`.
props.readOnly: Whether the text can't be changed. The popup doesn't open.
props.required: Whether the input must have text for the form to submit. Validated by an enclosing `FieldRoot`.
props.loading: Whether the suggestions are being fetched: pass `pending? results` (and `results == null` before the first answer) for `results = await search(value)`. `AutocompleteEmpty` stays empty, the list is `aria-busy`, and the popup and list carry `data-loading`.

AutocompleteInput.description: The text input, with `role="combobox"`. Its text is the value: give it a `name` to submit it with a form. Typing opens the popup; the arrow keys move the highlight while focus stays here; Enter chooses the highlighted suggestion.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

AutocompleteTrigger.description: A button beside the input that opens and closes the popup and leaves focus in the input. It isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

AutocompleteClear.description: A button that empties the input and focuses it. It is rendered only while the input has text, and isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

props.keepMounted: Whether to render the button while the input is empty. Default: false.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

AutocompleteValue.description: The input's text, shown somewhere else, or the placeholder while it is empty.

props.placeholder: Shown while the input is empty (the part then carries `data-placeholder`).

dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present while the input is empty and the placeholder is shown.
dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the popup is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-readonly: Present when the autocomplete is read-only.

AutocompletePopup.description: The popup: an element with `popover="manual"`, placed against the input with CSS anchor positioning and at least as wide as it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`. A press inside it keeps focus in the input.

props.side: Which side of the input it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit. Default: `"bottom"`.
props.align: Which edge of the input it lines up with. Default: `"start"`.
props.sideOffset: Gap between input and popup, in pixels. Default: 0.
props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the input's edge from its `align` position, in pixels. Default: 0.

dataAttributes.data-empty: Present while no suggestion matches what was typed.
dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the input the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
dataAttributes.data-loading: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

AutocompleteList.description: The listbox that holds the suggestions. The input's `aria-controls` points at it.

dataAttributes.data-empty: Present while no suggestion matches what was typed.
dataAttributes.data-loading: Present while the root's `loading` is true; the list is `aria-busy` then too.

AutocompleteItem.description: A suggestion. Choosing it fills the input with its label and closes the popup. It isn't rendered while it doesn't match what was typed (modes `"list"` and `"both"`).

props.value: Identifies the suggestion. The input is filled with its label, not this.
props.label: The text the filter matches and the input is filled with. Default: the suggestion's text.
props.disabled: Whether the suggestion can't be highlighted or chosen.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the suggestion is highlighted: the input's `aria-activedescendant`.
dataAttributes.data-selected: Never present on a suggestion: an autocomplete has no selection.

AutocompleteGroup.description: Groups related suggestions under an `AutocompleteGroupLabel`. It gets `hidden` while none of its suggestions match.

AutocompleteGroupLabel.description: The heading of a group. The group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

AutocompleteEmpty.description: A `role="status"` element whose children show while no suggestion is rendered, except while the root is `loading`. The element stays in the document, empty, otherwise.

AutocompleteStatus.description: A `role="status"` element with `aria-live="polite"`, for a message about the list, such as a result count.

AutocompleteSeparator.description: A horizontal `role="separator"` between suggestions or groups.

AutocompleteArrow.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the input, centred on it. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the input the popup is on. Absent until the popup first opens; a close keeps the last side.
